notes: Every one of the 33 numbered sub-changes in human-642-662-resolution.json appears in the snapshot. Each is in the right line and the right word. No form left over from before a change remains.

Matched against the stated answers: 642 בַּתָּֽוֶךְ (dagesh and meteg). 643 and 644: נִבְדַּל, נֶחְדַּל, נֶאֱצַל, וְנִבְדַּל, וְנֶחְדַּל, רַק, all with patah. 645: line 1 is exactly 'אֵין מָרְאֶה וְגַב לְאִחוּדֶֽךָ', and לְעוֹצֶם has sheva under the lamed. 646: כְּמִדָּתֶֽךָ, כִּגְדֻלָּתְךָ, and תְּבוּנָתֶֽךָ with the initial tav dagesh. 647: חָלַֽקְתָּ (lamed meteg), חֲכָמִים (no kaf meteg), תְּמַלְּאֵם (lamed dagesh). 649: לִגְדֻלָּתֶֽךָ (qubuts and lamed dagesh). 650: תּוּכָל and בִּלְתֶּֽךָ. 651: מִלֵּאתָ (no meteg). 652: מִעֲטֽוּךָ, לְחֲצוּךָ, יְצוּרֶֽיךָ. 653: הַשָּׁמָֽיִם. 654: קֵרְבוּךָ, כִּי כָל, יְחַלְּקוּךָ. 655: זֶֽרֶם and מַֽיִם. 656: לַהֲוַיוֹתְךָ. 657: וְעוֹדֶף. 658: הָיִֽיתָ (line 25) and אָֽתָּה. 659: נוֹדַֽעְתָּ. 660: וְיָעִֽידוּ (meteg on the ayin), יַסְהִֽידוּ (meteg on the he), בְּתֽוֹקֶף (meteg on the tav, none on the qof), and both יְקָרְךָ unchanged. 661: line 22 ends with a colon. 662: עֵת with tsere.

The changes are bounded. The only differences between the earlier and current text are the human-answered words. The 28 earlier provisional meteg and vowel changes are unaffected. The consonants are unchanged throughout, including the extra vav in לַהֲוַיוֹתְךָ and the defective spelling of כִּגְדֻלָּתְךָ and לִגְדֻלָּתֶֽךָ.
